policies.rule: Use pinyin with surname first, no tone marks, no spaces between syllables.
Keep original pinyin forms (surname + kinship/affectionate marker) for recurring terms; translate meaning only if opaque or used once.
Translate descriptive titles; romanize proper titles on first use with translation in parentheses, then use translation thereafter.
Keep original pinyin for system/product names; add a brief descriptive gloss in parentheses on first mention only.
Use US spelling; hyphenate compound modifiers before nouns, leave open otherwise.
Narration: past tense, neutral register. Dialogue: match speaker’s age/status/contract; contractions for informal speech, none for formal.
